expectation: Membrane-rim PDL1 on a minority of cells: CD14+ macrophages and dendritic cells, possibly some tumour cells. Scattered single cells or clusters in stroma and tumour margin, mostly absent from lymphocyte-dense regions.
observed: A: broad yellow haze in every core, strength varying by core. B/C: patchy yellow bands in stroma-like areas, sparse in nuclei-dense zones, plus a few bright blobs. D: diffuse meshwork, no clear rings. E: PDL1 mesh everywhere, brightest and white where CD14 is dense, but also green in CD14-negative areas.
why: PDL1 is mostly diffuse haze, but it is somewhat enriched in CD14-dense regions and patchy in the stroma, which suggests a real low-contrast signal.
